note: Design tokens for the bundle banner series. One palette per pillar, taken from the water lexicon of SYSTEM-PRODUKTLINIE.md: every pillar is a body of water with its own light. Colours are dark-based on purpose - a banner carries its own background and must read the same in a light and a dark README.

typography.sans: 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif

title.note: The title is fitted, not stepped: a long bundle name shrinks until it clears the scene. max_width is the run from the left margin to where the scene begins; advance_ratio is an estimate of average glyph advance at weight 600, deliberately erring wide, because SVG has no text metrics at write time.

memory.label: Tiefenwasser
memory.meaning: Das Gedaechtnis traegt und ist der zurueckgelegte Weg. Die Tiefe haelt, was war.

control.label: Klarwasser
control.meaning: Der Steuerstand: klares, ruhiges Wasser, in dem man den Kurs sieht.

uas.label: Hafen
uas.meaning: Der Ort, an dem Mensch und System aneinander andocken. Verschiedene Netze fangen verschiedenen Fisch - die Fischarten sind die Endprodukte als Lebensmittel.

domain.label: Frachtwasser
domain.meaning: Das Fachgut als Fracht: umgeschlagen, gestapelt, transportiert.

palette_rationale.why_dark: The banner sits in a README that may render light or dark. A dark body of water with its own light source reads identically in both; a light banner would need a second variant per bundle.
palette_rationale.why_warm_accent_for_uas: The harbour is the human contact point, so it is the only pillar whose accent is warm: quay lamp amber against harbour green. The other three keep cold accents.
palette_rationale.accent_use: The accent appears exactly three times per banner: pillar chip, bottom rule, and one single element in the scene. It marks, it does not decorate.
palette_rationale.colour_roles: hull = silhouettes (piles, quay, hull), abyss = deepest background, deep = sky, mid = water body, surface = waterline and light on water, accent = the one warm or bright mark, ink = title, muted = secondary text.
